name: CapCut Green-Screen VFX Insert Behind Subject
use_when: An explosion, smoke, meme effect, screen element, or stylized VFX should be inserted into a shot.
The VFX asset can be chroma-keyed or has a clean background that can be removed.
The effect should sit behind the subject, requiring a duplicated foreground cutout layer.
avoid_when: The VFX asset is copyrighted, unclear, watermarked, or not safe for the intended platform.
The chroma key leaves obvious green edges or removes desired VFX detail.
The effect does not match the camera perspective, scale, light, or tone of the shot.
The foreground subject cutout cannot be made clean enough to sell the behind-subject layer.

timeline_pattern.pattern: base_clip -> vfx_overlay -> crop_to_effect -> chroma_key_green -> scale_position_match -> optional_brightness_match -> duplicate_base_above -> remove_background_subject -> cinematic_filter_or_grade -> sound_sync_qc
timeline_pattern.rights_rule: Treat downloaded or screen-recorded green-screen assets as temp until rights or platform safety are confirmed.
timeline_pattern.placement_rule: Align the VFX as if it exists in the scene before putting the subject cutout above it.
timeline_pattern.sandwich_rule: Use a bottom base clip, middle keyed VFX, and top foreground subject cutout when the effect should appear behind the person.
timeline_pattern.match_rule: Adjust brightness, contrast, blur, and grade so the keyed VFX does not look pasted on.

motion.rule: The VFX peak should land on the action beat, reaction, or music cue that motivates the insert.

keyframe_values.trim: Trim the VFX to the active effect range before keying.
keyframe_values.crop: Crop away unused green-screen area before scaling when possible.
keyframe_values.scale_position: Match the implied depth and location before applying the foreground sandwich.
keyframe_values.foreground_alignment: The duplicated top subject layer must stay frame-aligned with the base clip.

sound.rule: Add VFX sound only after the visual impact frame is locked; keep it below dialogue and license-safe.

captions.rule: Captions should avoid the VFX impact and foreground cutout edge; suppress or move them during the effect if needed.

color.rule: Keyed VFX may need brightness reduction, contrast control, blur, or shared grade so it fits the plate.

implementation.ffmpeg: Use chromakey/colorkey to remove green, crop and scale the VFX, overlay it between base and foreground alpha layers, and align SFX to the VFX peak frame.
implementation.remotion: Model VfxInsert with assetRef, licenseStatus, chromaColor, tolerance, crop, transform, impactFrame, foregroundMaskRef, and soundCueFrame.
implementation.blender: Use keying/compositor nodes for the VFX, place it between background and subject matte layers, and match color/blur in the compositor.
implementation.capcut_equivalent: Add the green-screen VFX as overlay, trim/crop it, use Cutout/Chroma Key and tune intensity, scale/position it, duplicate the base clip above the VFX, use Remove Background on the top layer, then add grade/filter and synced SFX.
implementation.premiere_equivalent: Use Ultra Key on the VFX layer, crop/position/grade it, duplicate/rotoscope the subject above it or use After Effects Roto Brush, then align SFX with markers.

common_mistakes: Using a green-screen asset from the web without license or platform-safety review.
Leaving green spill or keyed holes in the VFX.
Placing the VFX on top of the subject when it should sit behind them.
Forgetting to duplicate and align the foreground subject layer.
Adding an explosion or impact that does not match the shot's scale, lighting, or tone.
qc: Is the VFX asset source/license/platform status documented?
Does the chroma key remove green without damaging the VFX?
Does the VFX sit at a plausible scale and position in the shot?
Is the top foreground subject layer frame-aligned and edge-clean?
Does the SFX land on the VFX impact frame and stay below speech?
Do captions avoid the impact and cutout edges?
